name: Shipi – Multi-Carrier Shipping Plugin for WooCommerce
author: Aarsiv Groups

sections.description:
Shipi is the ultimate shipping solution for WooCommerce stores. Whether you’re shipping with FedEx, DHL, UPS, Aramex, or others (Full List) – Shipi simplifies the process.

Easily compare live shipping rates, generate shipping labels in 1 click, print invoices and packing slips, and track shipments automatically.

No coding. No hassle. Just powerful WooCommerce shipping made easy.

Top Features:
– 📦 Real-time shipping rates from 15+ carriers (FedEx, DHL, UPS, Aramex, etc.)
– 🏷️ Instant shipping label generation after order creation
– 📊 Compare shipping options at checkout and backend
– 🧾 Print invoice & packing slips
– 🔁 Automatic order status updates via webhook
– 📬 Email customers with tracking info & delivery status
– 🌍 Multi-country support with custom shipper accounts
– 🔌 Fully integrated into the WooCommerce order page

Why Choose Shipi?
– Save time with automation
– Improve delivery experience for your customers
– Built and tested for WooCommerce 100%

Start shipping like a pro in just 2 minutes.

For a full visual guide, visit Documentation

Third-Party Services

This plugin connects to Shipi’s shipping API to:
– Link your site to your Shipi account
– Retrieve live shipping rates
– Generate shipping labels
– Load carrier data and brand assets
– Track shipments and notify customers

API Endpoints used:
– https://app.myshipi.com/api/link-site.php
– https://app.myshipi.com/embed/label.php
– https://app.myshipi.com/label_api/entry.php
– https://app.myshipi.com/assets/img/brand/
– https://app.myshipi.com/carriers.php
– https://app.myshipi.com/rates_api/shipi_rates.php

See Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/shipi, or install it via the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin from your WordPress dashboard under Plugins.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping and add Shipi as a shipping method.
  4. Connect your Shipi account or create one to begin configuration.
  5. Start generating labels and comparing rates inside each order.

For a full visual guide, visit https://myshipi.com/Shipi-Integration-Document
sections.faq:
Which carriers are supported?

Shipi supports FedEx, DHL, UPS, Aramex, Canada Post, DPD, DB Schenker, PostNord, and more.

Can I use my own carrier account?

Yes! You can integrate your own account credentials for any supported carrier.

How do I generate a shipping label?

Just go to WooCommerce > Orders, open an order, select a carrier, and click “Generate Shipping Label.”

Is there a free version of Shipi?

Yes. Shipi offers a free plan with core features and paid plans for advanced usage. Check our website for details.

Does Shipi track shipments?

Yes. Shipi automatically tracks shipment progress and updates WooCommerce order status accordingly.
